This food uses rice with a little vinegar. It often has raw fish on top. You can eat small pieces with your hands or with chopsticks.

次の英語の説明が指すものは何でしょう？
This Japanese food is easy to carry. You can eat it with your hands. It is made from rice and often has something inside. It may be a triangle with seaweed around it.

次の英語の説明が指すものは何でしょう？
This warm Japanese soup often comes with rice. Small white squares and seaweed may float in it. A salty brown paste made from beans gives it flavor.

次の英語の説明が指すものは何でしょう？
You eat long noodles in hot soup. Meat, eggs, and seaweed often sit on top. In Japan, shops may serve this dish with a spoon and chopsticks.

次の英語の説明が指すものは何でしょう？
These Japanese noodles are thick and white. They are made from wheat flour. You can eat them in hot soup or dip them into sauce when cold.

次の英語の説明が指すものは何でしょう？
These thin Japanese noodles are often gray or brown. Their flour comes from a plant other than wheat. Many people eat them on the last evening of December.

次の英語の説明が指すものは何でしょう？
Cooks cover fish or vegetables with a light wet mixture. They put them into hot oil. The outside becomes crisp, and people often dip the pieces in sauce.

次の英語の説明が指すものは何でしょう？
A thin piece of dough holds meat and vegetables inside. Its edge is folded shut. In Japan, people often fry one side until it becomes brown and crisp.

次の英語の説明が指すものは何でしょう？
This meal has rice beside a thick, spicy sauce. Meat, potatoes, and carrots often go into it. Many Japanese families cook a large pot of it at home.

次の英語の説明が指すものは何でしょう？
These small balls are cooked in a special pan. People put sauce on them and eat them hot. They are soft inside. Each one usually has a small piece of octopus in it.

次の英語の説明が指すものは何でしょう？
Cabbage goes into a thick mixture that cooks on a hot flat plate. Meat or seafood may be added. A dark sauce and mayonnaise often cover this round dish.

次の英語の説明が指すものは何でしょう？
Small pieces of chicken are put on thin wooden sticks. They cook over heat until ready. Shops often let you choose salt or a sweet, dark sauce.

次の英語の説明が指すものは何でしょう？
A thick piece of pork is covered in breadcrumbs. It is fried in oil and cut into strips. Thinly cut cabbage often sits beside it.

次の英語の説明が指すものは何でしょう？
People cook very thin meat at the table. They move each piece through hot water for a short time. Then they dip it into sauce before eating it.

次の英語の説明が指すものは何でしょう？
Thin beef cooks in a shallow pot with vegetables and other foods. The sauce tastes sweet and salty. In Japan, some people dip the cooked pieces into raw egg.

次の英語の説明が指すものは何でしょう？
This Japanese dish warms people on cold days. Eggs, white radish, and fish cakes cook slowly in a light soup. Shops sometimes sell individual pieces from a large hot pot.

次の英語の説明が指すものは何でしょう？
Fresh fish is cut into small slices for this dish. It is served without cooking and without rice underneath. People often dip it in a dark, salty sauce.

次の英語の説明が指すものは何でしょう？
These cooked beans have a strong smell. When you stir them, long sticky threads appear. Many people in Japan put them on rice and eat them for breakfast.

次の英語の説明が指すものは何でしょう？
This soft white food comes from beans. It is often sold as a square block in water. You can eat it cold or add it to hot soup.

次の英語の説明が指すものは何でしょう？
This soft Japanese dish comes in a small cup. Eggs and light soup are cooked together with steam. Chicken or mushrooms may hide inside, but it is not a sweet dessert.

次の英語の説明が指すものは何でしょう？
Rice sits in a bowl with small toppings such as fish or seaweed. Hot tea or light soup is poured over it. It is a simple, quick Japanese meal.

次の英語の説明が指すものは何でしょう？
This rice bowl has chicken and soft cooked egg on top. They cook together in a sweet, salty sauce. Its Japanese name connects a parent with its child.

次の英語の説明が指すものは何でしょう？
A thin layer of cooked egg covers fried rice in this dish. The rice often tastes of tomato sauce. Cooks sometimes write a message on top with red sauce.

次の英語の説明が指すものは何でしょう？
Cooked rice goes into a very hot pan. A cook quickly mixes it with egg, vegetables, and sometimes meat. The small grains are fried rather than served in soup.

次の英語の説明が指すものは何でしょう？
Noodles cook on a hot plate with cabbage and meat. A dark sauce gives them their usual flavor. Red pickled ginger is often placed on top of this dish.

次の英語の説明が指すものは何でしょう？
This food has a flat bread base. Tomato sauce and cheese often cover it. People bake it, cut it into triangle pieces, and share it with their friends.

次の英語の説明が指すものは何でしょう？
You hold this meal in your hands. A round piece of cooked meat sits between two halves of bread. Lettuce, cheese, and sauce may also be placed inside.

次の英語の説明が指すものは何でしょう？
Two slices of bread hold other foods between them. Eggs, vegetables, or ham are common fillings. You can eat this cold, so people often take it on trips.

次の英語の説明が指すものは何でしょう？
A long bread roll is cut open for this food. One long sausage sits inside it. People often add red tomato sauce and yellow mustard before eating it.

次の英語の説明が指すものは何でしょう？
These long, thin noodles come from Italian cooking. People boil them in water, then mix them with sauce. You often turn a fork to gather them before eating.

次の英語の説明が指すものは何でしょう？
This baked dish often has a creamy white sauce. Cheese and sometimes breadcrumbs cover the top. The surface turns brown in the oven while the inside stays soft.

次の英語の説明が指すものは何でしょう？
This Spanish dish cooks in a wide, shallow pan. Rice takes in the flavor of the soup as it cooks. Seafood or meat often sits on its yellow surface.

次の英語の説明が指すものは何でしょう？
This Mexican food uses a thin, flat piece of bread made from corn or wheat. It folds around meat and vegetables. You hold the filled piece while eating it.

次の英語の説明が指すものは何でしょう？
These Korean vegetables taste hot and sour. Red pepper gives them their bright color. Chinese cabbage is often used, and the food slowly develops its flavor while being stored.

次の英語の説明が指すものは何でしょう？
A thin skin wraps meat and hot soup together. This Chinese food is cooked with steam in small baskets. Bite carefully, because the liquid inside can burn your mouth.

次の英語の説明が指すものは何でしょう？
Vegetables and sometimes meat are wrapped in a thin square skin. The cook rolls it into a tube and fries it. Its golden outside breaks with a crisp sound.

次の英語の説明が指すものは何でしょう？
This warm snack has soft white bread outside and meat inside. It is cooked with steam instead of in an oven. Japanese stores often sell it during cold weather.

次の英語の説明が指すものは何でしょう？
Soft cooked potato is mixed with meat or vegetables. It is shaped, covered in breadcrumbs, and fried. The outside is crisp, but the middle stays soft.

次の英語の説明が指すものは何でしょう？

次の英語の説明が指すものは何でしょう？
Large green leaves wrap around small rolls of meat. These bundles cook slowly in soup until soft. The leaves come from a round vegetable often sliced for salads.

次の英語の説明が指すものは何でしょう？
Finely cut meat is mixed and shaped into a thick, flat piece. It is cooked in a pan and served on a plate. In Japan, rice often comes beside it.

次の英語の説明が指すものは何でしょう？
A thick slice of meat is cooked on a very hot surface. People choose how much to cook the middle. You usually cut each bite with a knife.

次の英語の説明が指すものは何でしょう？
Small pieces of meat are flavored before cooking. They get a thin coat of flour or starch, then go into hot oil. Chicken is especially common in this Japanese dish.

次の英語の説明が指すものは何でしょう？

次の英語の説明が指すものは何でしょう？
Potatoes are cut into very thin, flat slices. After cooking, they are dry and crisp. This salty snack often comes in a bag and breaks easily when you bite it.

次の英語の説明が指すものは何でしょう？
Small hard grains suddenly become larger when heated. They turn into light white shapes with an uneven surface. People often eat this snack from a box while watching films.

次の英語の説明が指すものは何でしょう？
This Japanese snack is usually flat and hard. It is made from rice and often tastes salty. Some pieces have a shiny brown coating or a strip of seaweed.

次の英語の説明が指すものは何でしょう？

次の英語の説明が指すものは何でしょう？

次の英語の説明が指すものは何でしょう？

次の英語の説明が指すものは何でしょう？

次の英語の説明が指すものは何でしょう？

次の英語の説明が指すものは何でしょう？

次の英語の説明が指すものは何でしょう？

次の英語の説明が指すものは何でしょう？

次の英語の説明が指すものは何でしょう？

次の英語の説明が指すものは何でしょう？

次の英語の説明が指すものは何でしょう？

次の英語の説明が指すものは何でしょう？

次の英語の説明が指すものは何でしょう？

次の英語の説明が指すものは何でしょう？
